english.title: Owner / master / charterer of fishing boat breach EC measure regarding undersized fish in sea adjoining Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 3(1) and 4 of, and the Schedule to, the Sea Fishing (Enforcement ofCommunity Conservation Measures) (Wales) Order 2000.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
contravene or failure to comply
with, any specified Community measure
in respect of any fishing boat within the sea adjacent to Wales or the entry into the sea adjacent to Wales
by any fishing boat, the master, the owner and the charterer (if any) of such fishing boat
retains, lands, transports, stores, sells, displays or offers for sale
any undersized fish
in contravention of any specified Community measure OR any salmon (Salmo salar) or sea trout (Salmo trutta) in contravention of Articles 26(1) or 36 of Regulation 850/98

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Article 4(3) of the Order provides that the court by or before which a person is convicted of the offence, may order the forfeiture of any fish in respect of which the offence was committed; and in respect of an offence under article 3(1) of this Order, the forfeiture of any net or other fishing gear used in committing the offence.

other.penalty:
Summary: Statutory maximum fine.
Indictment: A fine.

None
